Differentiator: successor to Compound Engineering and the old do-work skill; remote tracker (do-work.io or Linear); native review cycle (max 5, user can interrupt).

name: dw
description: ユーザーが Codex で $dw / $dw next / $dw review / $dw approve、 または Claude Code で /dw / /dw next / /dw review / /dw approve を入力したときに このスキルを有効化し、scripts/workflow.py を実行します。

name: dw-01-research-questions
description: Use when starting a new deep-work task. Decomposes a task description into objective research questions that avoid premature solutioning. Phase 1 of the deep-work pipeline.

name: dw-02-research
description: Use when you have research questions from deep-work Phase 1. Objectively investigates the codebase to answer pasted questions without access to the original task description.

name: dw-03-design-discussion
description: Use when deep-work Phase 2 research is complete. Combines research findings with the original task to explore design options, evaluate tradeoffs, and make decisions interactively.

name: dw-04-outline
description: Use when deep-work Phase 3 design decisions are complete. Maps chosen decisions to concrete file changes organized into implementable phases.

name: dw-05-plan
description: Use when deep-work Phase 4 structure outline is complete. Expands the outline into a detailed implementation plan with exact file paths, code patterns, tests, and validation commands.

name: dw-06-implement
description: Use when deep-work Phase 5 plan is complete. Executes the implementation plan by dispatching a fresh subagent per task with two-stage review (spec compliance → code quality).

name: dw-adopt
description: Drive Delivery Workbench adoption for this repository (intake → discovery → roadmap).

name: dw-adr
description: Registra uma decisao arquitetural e os trade-offs aceitos, antes que se percam.

name: dw-analyze-project
description: Escaneia o repo para aprender stack e convencoes, e escreve as regras que os outros commands usam.

name: dw-ascend
description: Use when L1 filtering is complete and you need to synthesize coherent structure, flag design dependencies, and review global consistency. L2/L3 are LLM-driven heuristics inspired by H₁ loops and sheaf consistency; Gini-trajectory monitoring is a real metric.

name: dw-autopilot
description: Trigger quando usuario pede pra implementar, criar ou adicionar uma feature nao-trivial. Primeira invocacao planeja e para; segunda retoma via dw-goal, depois commit e PR.

name: dw-backfill
description: 历史回填预演：目标环境、分区范围、幂等策略、检查点与扫描估算， 预演阶段只读不落盘。适用于需要重刷历史分区时。
allowed_tools: Read, Glob, Bash(dw plan:*), Bash(dw reconcile:*)

name: dw-beat
description: Use to produce a Datawrapper chart beat after the journalist chooses Datawrapper for an eligible storyboard treatment — map the editorial contract onto the Datawrapper v3 API, persist the provider chart ID, and take back an owned PNG or published web artifact. Rendering is delegated; this skill holds no geometry or seed component.

name: dw-bench-eval
description: Evaluates LLMs' ability to reason about data warehouse graph topologies, specifically focusing on foreign key path enumeration, data lineage impact analysis, and multi-hop graph traversal. It probes whether models can perform structural graph reasoning versus relying on lexical cues, using heterogeneous schema graphs with foreign key and lineage edges. Use when the user wants to benchmark on DW-Bench, or asks about evaluating this task. Reports Micro-EM.

name: dw-bootstrap
description: 初始化/迁移 dw-harness 到当前项目（写 AGENTS.md、rules、harness.json，合并 settings.json）。仅在用户明确要求安装或升级 harness 时使用。
allowed_tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Bash(dw init:*), Bash(dw doctor:*)

name: dw-brainstorm
description: Refina uma ideia concreta contra features existentes do produto. Modos: ideacao, --research, --onepager, --council. Use dw-opportunities antes de ter uma ideia e dw-refactor para auditoria de code health.

name: dw-bug-diagnosis
description: bug 诊断与修复纪律：先查重复历史，再造出一条能变红的复现回路，之后才提可证伪的假设、修复并防回归，最后归档进 bug 修复历史。修 bug、查回归、解释异常行为、测试莫名失败、线上报错要定位、'为什么坏了'这类任务在动手改代码之前用。新功能开发用 dw-workflow；修复后的评审用 dw-review-gate。

name: dw-bugfix
description: Trigger quando usuario reporta bug, cola erro ou descreve comportamento quebrado. Tria com tres perguntas, depois corrige ou roteia pra PRD.

name: dw-chaos-engineering
description: Use to adversarially test a change you just implemented. Maps the attack surface, writes tests that try to break it, classifies each KILLED/SURVIVED/INCONCLUSIVE. Local only, writes tests only, 3 rounds max. Ask for it by name.

name: dw-check
description: 发布前统一验收：跑 dw check 汇总 lint/契约/DDL/DQC/对账证据， 输出四态（PASS/FAIL/UNVERIFIED/N-A）报告。适用于合并/上线前最后关口。

name: dw-check
description: A second opinion on the diff so far, mid-build: what is wrong with it, and does it fit this repo? One quick pass reads the diff here, and an outside reviewer — codex — is offered afterwards as confirmation rather than run by default; every mistake either one names is verified at a real file:line before it counts, then fixed in-session on your approval.

name: dw-clarify-intent
description: Default initial intake for non-trivial workflow requests; use relentlessly when intent, scope, risk, verification, or downstream routing could otherwise be guessed.

name: dw-claude-run
description: Trigger quando usuario pede pra rodar/disparar o Claude (claude -p headless) numa worktree dedicada pra implementar um prompt/spec preparado. Adapter Claude sobre o protocolo dw-cli-run: log de auditoria duravel, sessao resumivel via --session-id, dupla avaliacao 0-10, PARA pro gate. Nunca no checkout principal; nunca mergeia.

name: dw-cli-run
description: Execute an approved task through a Codex, Claude or Copilot CLI adapter, with isolated Git work, durable sessions and a reviewed handoff.

name: dw-cli-run
description: Shared runner protocol for the dw-*-run commands (dw-codex-run / dw-claude-run / dw-copilot-run). Fires an autonomous AI CLI (Codex / Claude / Copilot) INSIDE a dedicated git worktree to implement a prepared prompt/spec, with streaming captured to a durable audit log, a resumable per-task session, a 0–10 dual evaluation, graded escalation, and a STOP for the human gate. Loaded by those commands — substitute the CLI-specific adapter table they supply. NEVER runs in the main checkout; NEVER auto-merges (the owner decides after the gate).

name: dw-code-facts
description: 代码事实层 engineering-context 与 ctx CLI：查某个能力的权威实现在哪个仓库哪个接口、跨服务影响面、哪份是废弃的旧实现；每条事实带 cite；查不到卡片就读源码并当场补卡；碰了权威面要刷卡；每次合并写 CHANGELOG 条目；升级上游版本前读依赖声明；探测到代码图谱（codegraph）时做结构检索。写 spec 的既有系统清单、动手改一个没读过的模块、'ctx 命令找不到 / 返回空'、要 clone 外部仓库取证、要设计 registry 或场景蓝图或探针集时用。文档目录与归档用 dw-doc-governance；bug 复现与假设用 dw-bug-diagnosis。

name: dw-codebase-intel
description: Use to query or build codebase intel (.dw/intel/ — stack, files, apis, deps, arch). Powers /dw-intel queries and /dw-intel --build. Invoke on 'where is X', 'what uses Y', or after refactors.

name: dw-codex-run
description: Trigger quando usuario pede pra rodar/disparar o Codex (codex exec) numa worktree dedicada pra implementar um prompt/spec preparado. Adapter Codex sobre o protocolo dw-cli-run: log de auditoria duravel, sessao resumivel por tarefa, dupla avaliacao 0-10, PARA pro gate. Nunca no checkout principal; nunca mergeia.

name: dw-commerce-b2b
description: Implement Dynamicweb 10 B2B customer groups, scoped assortments, and sales workflows. Triggers: DC scoping, CSR sales-on-behalf, build or fix a customer assortment. Non-triggers: standard ecommerce -> dw-commerce-orders; product data -> dw-pim-modelling.

name: dw-commerce-catalog
description: Render Dynamicweb 10 catalogs and assortments, and manage currency-specific prices. Triggers: ProductListViewModel, catalog display, assortment rendering, currency conversion, set product price. Non-triggers: orders or checkout -> dw-commerce-orders.

name: dw-commerce-cpq
description: Build Carrot Solutions CPQ configurators on DW10. Triggers: input/BOM/price rules, Lookup Lists, CPQ pages/cards, ERP requirements, blank pages or empty options. Product variants/BOM -> dw-pim-modelling; discounts -> dw-commerce-orders.

name: dw-commerce-orders
description: Handle Dynamicweb 10 orders, carts, checkout, payments, shipments, discounts, and vouchers. Triggers: troubleshoot an order or payment, checkout flow, cart handling, promotion, coupon. Non-triggers: catalog -> dw-commerce-catalog; B2B -> dw-commerce-b2b.

name: dw-commit
description: Trigger quando implementacao esta completa e ha mudancas pendentes pra commit. Commits atomicos com mensagens Conventional Commits.

name: dw-content-localization
description: Create language versions of Dynamicweb 10 sites and translate page content. Triggers: translate a page, site, or area; create a website language version. Non-triggers: product translation -> dw-pim-localization; item types -> dw-content-modelling.

name: dw-content-modelling
description: Model Dynamicweb 10 item types, paragraphs, pages, fields, and assets. Triggers: design content structure; create, edit, copy, move, or publish a page or paragraph. Non-triggers: Razor rendering -> dw-render-razor; translation -> dw-content-localization.

name: dw-context-budget
description: Audita overhead de contexto em comandos, skills, agentes, instrucoes e MCPs; recomenda economia de tokens.

name: dw-continue-skill
description: Resume from the handoff dw-handoff already wrote without re-planning; invoke /dw-continue.

name: dw-contract
description: 表契约操作：校验、编译、与基线 diff、记录破坏性变更的迁移决定。 适用于新增/修改字段口径、金额单位变更、与基线比对时。

name: dw-contract
description: Generate and honestly certify the commit contract for the staged work.

name: dw-copilot-run
description: Trigger quando usuario pede pra rodar/disparar o GitHub Copilot CLI (copilot -p) numa worktree dedicada pra implementar um prompt/spec preparado. Adapter Copilot sobre o protocolo dw-cli-run: log de auditoria duravel, sessao resumivel, dupla avaliacao 0-10, PARA pro gate. Nunca no checkout principal; nunca mergeia.

name: dw-council
description: Multi-advisor debate (3-5 archetypes) with steel-manning and dissent preserved, for high-stakes product or architecture calls.

name: dw-data-access
description: Choose DW10 data-access surfaces and caching patterns. Triggers: MCP vs Management API vs serializer vs SQL, action ladder, cache invalidation, SQL gotchas. C# coding -> dw-extend-csharp-api.

name: dw-data-audit-trail
description: Investigate DW10 audit logs and version history. Triggers: who changed a product/order/page, when a field was set, why a record changed, AuditQuery. Investigation only; reverting is a separate write.

name: dw-data-comparison
description: Step 5/8 数据比对：新旧表/上下游键级对账，产出可复跑的对账证据， 只回收差异摘要。适用于自测通过后与基线数据核对。
allowed_tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash(dw reconcile:*), Bash(dw check:*)

name: dw-data-write-effects
description: Verify DW10 writes and refresh dependent data. Triggers: save succeeded but value unchanged, stale search/products, missing index rows, prices or assortments not updated. Surface/cache mechanics -> dw-data-access.

name: dw-debug-protocol
description: Use when investigating a bug. Stop-the-line discipline + six-step triage (reproduce → localize → reduce → fix root cause → guard → verify). Triggers on every bug report, test failure, or /dw-bugfix.

name: dw-demo-base
description: Set up DW10 demos and build orchestration; baseline loading belongs to sister skills. Use FIRST for local/hosted demos, MCP connection/TLS failures, platform pinning, customisation audits, the native /demo:* commands, and branded-demo path choice.

name: dw-demo-erp
description: Model DW10 ERP demos with staged mock sync and reset. Triggers: ERP vs PIM ownership, ERP as source/target vs channel, demo data reset. Live BC connector -> dw-integration-bc. Use AFTER dw-demo-base.

name: dw-demo-foldback
description: Fold demo learnings into skills as sanitized PRs. Triggers: fold back a learning, save a demo fix to the plugin. General skill authoring -> dw-skill-authoring. Use AFTER dw-demo-base.

name: dw-demo-headless
description: Build DW10 headless demos with Next.js/vercel-commerce and a dedicated baseline. Triggers: decoupled storefront, Headless_* items, /dwapi auth/search errors, language data, self-signed host. Use AFTER dw-demo-base.

name: dw-demo-hosted
description: Build or publish DW10 demos on hosted/cloud installs using a URL and Admin API key. Triggers: local-to-hosted deployment, silent writes, cloned-host 500/ACL faults, CloudHosting recycle/version. Use AFTER dw-demo-base.

name: dw-demo-ledger
description: Select and check a release-pinned DW10 function ledger. Triggers: platform coverage, equivalent MCP/API probes, edition check locks, release capability changes. Use AFTER dw-demo-base.

name: dw-demo-pim
description: Build DW10 PIM demos from a blank database. Triggers: variants/BOM, workspaces/dashboards, completeness, approvals, team permissions, languages, GUID collisions, data-load/cache recovery. Use AFTER dw-demo-base.

name: dw-demo-swift
description: Build and rebrand Swift 2 demos from a baseline. Triggers: header/footer, mobile overflow/menu, customer center/impersonation, sign-in, checkout fields, stale paragraphs, language/group gating. Use AFTER dw-demo-base.

name: dw-deslop-skill
description: Strip AI slop from the code and prose just written — the over-commenting, defensive boilerplate, `any`-casts, dead code, needless abstraction, copy-paste, and the writing tells (filler openers, puffery, bold-everything, emoji bullets) a careful human reviewer would remove. Use before committing or opening a PR to clean a branch — "deslop this", "remove the AI slop", "clean up this branch", "is this slop", or invokes /dw-deslop [path|--staged]. Edits only the diff against the base branch, behavior-preserving, and keeps legitimate defensive code and comments at trust boundaries.

name: dw-doc-governance
description: 项目文档放哪、活多久、怎么退场：输出目录与命名、三层真相源（需求 / 架构 / 实现）、需求真相源只写现状、TODO 出口、决策记录、文档生命周期与 authority_refs、索引分层、按权威面归档、bug 修复历史与测试覆盖度两个账本。要新建文档定目录和文件名、往 REQUIREMENTS 或 TODO 写东西、判一篇 spec 该不该归档、整理 docs/index.md、立决策记录（ADR）、评审门文档轴结算时用。文字本身怎么写用 dw-prose；卡片与 CHANGELOG 用 dw-code-facts；从零写 PRD 用 dw-prd。

name: dw-dockerize
description: Le um projeto, detecta stack e deps de runtime, e propoe Dockerfile e docker-compose para dev e prod com trade-offs explicitos.

name: dw-doctor
description: Read-only environment diagnostic for a solo-lane repo: whether the tools the hooks and skills assume are installed, and whether the guardrails and the pre-commit really fire here or are silently skipping, each gap reported with a copy-paste fix.

name: dw-domain-modeling
description: Internal domain-vocabulary protocol for the native Grill flow.

name: dw-dqc
description: Step 8/8 SLA/DQC：从表契约生成稳定 ID 的 DQC 规则配置并校验漂移。 适用于任务上线前的质量规则配置。
allowed_tools: Read, Write, Bash(dw dqc:*), Bash(dw contract:*)

name: dw-env-skill
description: Owns the canonical workspace layout and local-environment readiness - one flat {workspace}/{repo} level, never a namespace subdir - with a deterministic preflight (Docker daemon, AWS credentials file, layout) and a bootstrap flow for new machines and repos. Use when the user says "clone", "checkout a repo", "set up the env", "bootstrap", "new machine", "install docker", "seed the local db", or when a restore/build fails on Docker or empty AWS credentials.

name: dw-etl
description: Step 3/8 数仓 ETL 开发：生成 MaxCompute 建表 DDL、INSERT SQL， 并由 hook 做写后规范反馈。适用于契约定稿后开始写表和任务 SQL。

name: dw-etl
description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "数据仓库建设", "数仓建设", "全流程建模", "端到端数仓", "DW ETL", "数据仓库全流程", "一键建模", or requests end-to-end data warehouse modeling from source DDL to DWS layer. Orchestrates the full pipeline: metadata_parse → ods_generator → dwm-matrix → cdm_modeling → dws-designer.

name: dw-execute
description: 执行阶段：读取 SPEC READY，用 subagent_fork 创建隔离子会话执行实现，回传 EXECUTION RECEIPT。子会话可使用全部工具并可提问。

name: dw-execute-phase
description: Use for task execution. Two agents: executor (wave-based parallel dispatch + deviation handling) and plan-checker (goal-backward verification). Invoked by /dw-run and /dw-autopilot.
allowed_tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob

name: dw-extend
description: Guide for building best-practice extensions for Dynamicweb and Dynamicweb Swift — covers NotificationSubscribers, Providers, ScheduledTasks, Razor template overrides, CSS customization, and ViewModel extensions.

name: dw-extend-admin-ui
description: Extend DW10 admin screens, sidebar trees and actions. Triggers: ListScreen, EditScreen, OverviewScreen, ScreenInjector, screens not rendering, dimmed injected actions. Assembly deployment -> dw-setup-cli.

name: dw-extend-admin-ui
description: Extend the Dynamicweb 10 administration interface from your own assembly — list, edit and overview screens, an area in the sidebar, nodes in an area tree, entries in an existing Actions menu, and injectors into screens you do not own. Triggers: add a screen to the admin, ListScreen, EditScreen, OverviewScreen, ScreenInjector, an area or tree node in the sidebar, add a button or Actions-menu entry to an existing screen, change a screen someone else owns, my screen compiles and installs but never renders, an injected action renders dimmed and inert. Non-triggers: providers, notification subscri…

name: dw-extend-csharp-api
description: Write DW10 backend logic with the C# API. Triggers: Services, Pageview, Context.Current, UserContext. ViewModels -> dw-render-viewmodels; event subscribers -> dw-extend-providers.

name: dw-extend-mcp-tools
description: Add tools to the Dynamicweb MCP project. Triggers: new MCP operation/domain, tool classes, services, models, route handlers. Existing API internals -> dw-source-explorer.

name: dw-extend-providers
description: Build DW10 providers, AddIns and notification subscribers. Triggers: save/delete events, custom price/shipping/payment/authentication logic. Scheduled jobs -> dw-extend-scheduled-tasks.

name: dw-extend-scheduled-tasks
description: Create and manage DW10 scheduled tasks. Triggers: background jobs, scheduled task AddIns, RunSqlScheduledTaskAddIn. Event notifications -> dw-extend-providers.

name: dw-filter
description: Use when raw artifacts have been collected (L0 complete) and you need to identify stable clusters, viable approaches, or persistent structure. L1 layer — applies Vietoris-Rips filtration and H₀ persistent clustering to route modules.

name: dw-find-skills
description: Busca no ecossistema npx skills uma skill que resolva o que voce precisa, valida e instala onde voce escolher.

name: dw-flow-skill
description: Conductor that takes a substantial task from understanding through a merge-ready PR — grounds context, grills the plan, implements, deslops, reviews, ships — delegating to the other dw-* skills at each step and surveying in-scope skills as it goes. Use for clearly-substantial plan→ship work: "take RD-1234 to a PR", "implement this and open a PR", "run the flow on this", "ship this end to end", or `/dw-flow [task]`. Engages only on multi-phase build/ship tasks — not quick questions, edits, or lookups; on self-engage it asks first. A directly invoked dw-* skill still runs. A later change of dir…

name: dw-functional-doc
description: Mapeia telas e fluxos em um dossie funcional, validado E2E com Playwright.

name: dw-generate-pr
description: Trigger quando commits estao prontos e branch precisa de PR. Push da branch e abre PR com summary + test plan + hard verify gate.

name: dw-git-discipline
description: Use when committing or opening a PR. Atomic commits (one intent), Conventional Commits, trunk-based pattern, branch hygiene. Use for /dw-commit or /dw-generate-pr, not ordinary Git inspection.

name: dw-git-discipline
description: Use when committing or opening a PR. Atomic commits (one intent), Conventional Commits, trunk-based pattern, branch hygiene. Triggers before /dw-commit, /dw-generate-pr, or any git operation.

name: dw-git-ops-skill
description: The single git owner for the suite — the one place the commit / push / branch / PR flows live, so agents route all git through it instead of hand-rolling commands or reinventing a "gitflow" script. Use whenever a task involves committing, pushing, creating a branch or worktree, opening a PR or flipping it draft↔ready, cleaning up finished worktrees, or ANY destructive git (reset, force-push, clean, branch delete). Worktree-first: one worktree = one branch = one scope = one PR, reaped when the PR merges. Everyday git runs through scripts/ops.sh; destructive git runs raw under the judgment rubr…

name: dw-goal
description: Trigger quando trabalho longo precisa de objetivo duravel. Contrato portavel estilo Codex goal; usado pelo autopilot apos o planejamento.

name: dw-grain
description: Audit code just written for excess the gate cannot see: a helper reinvented beside its canonical home, a wrapper with one caller, config for a case that never occurs, a shape the neighbouring files build differently, code this change stranded. One table, and every row is a deletion or a reuse. Explicit-invoke only.

name: dw-grill
description: Interview the user to sharpen a vague, half-formed or ambiguous idea into decided requirements before any of it gets built — a round asks every question whose prerequisites are settled, hardest first, each with a recommended answer, then plays back what is decided and what is still open, so the thinking is finished first.

name: dw-grilling
description: Internal decision-tree interview protocol for the native Grill flow.

name: dw-grilling-skill
description: A reusable interview engine that asks only product decisions with real impact before a task is acted on. A question must change what a person gets, or commit something expensive to undo, and still be open after user rules, dw-knowledge preferences, and the codebase are applied. Walks that short list one question at a time, each with a recommended default. Use when a plan still has a real product fork: "grill me on this", "stress-test this plan", "poke holes in this decision", "interview me before we build", "what haven't we decided", or invokes /dw-grill [topic]. Engineering defaults the harn…

name: dw-handoff
description: Compact the live session into `.ai/work/<slug>/HANDOFF.md` — how far into the current task you are, what is applied but uncommitted, and which dead ends are already ruled out, so the next context window resumes mid-task. Explicit-invoke only.

name: dw-handoff-skill
description: Compress the current work session into a clean handoff document — what was done, where things stand, and the exact next steps — so a fresh agent (or a human picking up tomorrow) can continue without re-deriving context. SCRUBS secrets before writing and ends with a suggested-next-skills section. Use when the user is wrapping up, running low on context, switching agents, or says "write a handoff", "hand this off", "summarize where we are for the next session", "compact this for a fresh agent", or invokes /dw-handoff [focus for the next session].

name: dw-harness-audit
description: Roda um scorecard deterministico da instalacao dev-workflow, agentes, MCPs, gates e disciplina de contexto.

name: dw-headless-delivery
description: Build decoupled frontends with the Dynamicweb 10 /dwapi/ delivery API. Triggers: headless CMS or commerce, REST API, React, Vue, Angular, HTMX, content or query endpoints. Non-triggers: Razor -> dw-render-razor; Swift storefront -> dw-swift-building.

name: dw-help
description: Lista comandos primarios e fluxos que os conectam. Passe --advanced para ver comandos internos/escondidos.

name: dw-incident-response
description: Use when production breaks or for postmortems. 5 phases (triage → investigation → resolution → comms → postmortem), runbook templates. Triggers on outage, SEV-1, SEV-2, on-call handoff.

name: dw-init
description: Scaffold a private/solo repo for the solo loop — `.ai/` (work / backlog / archive), `docs/decisions/`, `CONTEXT.md`, a tracked `AGENTS.md` with a Task Router and a size budget, the guardrail hooks, settings with a derived allow-list, and an optional pre-commit. Explicit-invoke only.

name: dw-install-aws-skills
description: Trigger quando usuario pede pra instalar expertise AWS, configurar MCP da AWS, ou adicionar agent skills AWS. Opt-in: clona skills curadas de aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws para .agents/skills/aws/ e registra o AWS MCP Server unificado (stdio via mcp-proxy-for-aws). Requer uv, aws cli e credenciais AWS.

name: dw-install-azure-skills
description: Trigger quando usuario pede pra instalar expertise Azure, configurar MCP do Microsoft docs, ou adicionar agent skills Azure. Opt-in: clona skills curadas de MicrosoftDocs/Agent-Skills para .agents/skills/azure/ e registra o Microsoft Learn MCP server.

name: dw-integration-bc
description: Connect live Business Central to a DW10 PIM demo via ngrok and the connector. Triggers: BC* unknown query/command, green Test Connection but no products, StaticLinkManager, connector defaults. Use AFTER dw-demo-base.

name: dw-integration-erp
description: Configure DW10 ERP connectors and data ownership. Triggers: ERP integration, source-of-truth mapping, connector configuration. Activity setup/troubleshooting -> dw-integration-framework.

name: dw-integration-framework
description: Configure, run and diagnose DW10 Data Integration activities. Triggers: source/target providers, CSV/XML/Excel/OData import/export, scheduling, failed or hanging activities. ERP ownership -> dw-integration-erp.

name: dw-intel
description: Inteligencia do codebase: modo query (default) responde citando .dw/intel/ + .dw/rules/; modo --build (re)constroi indice.

name: dw-knowledge-skill
description: Live cross-project agent memory — capture, recall, update, and prune reusable knowledge. Reach for this on ANY non-trivial task. RECALL before doing real work — "how do we run X here", "how did we do Y last time", "what did we decide about Z", "do we have notes on …". CAPTURE when a generalizable how-to procedure, product/domain fact, task/decision context, or gotcha worked and was costly or recurring — offer to save it. UPDATE an incomplete or outdated memory when you find one. Trigger phrasings: "remember this", "save this", "do we have notes on", "update what you know about". Stores the ME…

name: dw-land
description: You are done with a change: wrap it up and decide whether it is ready to merge. One last thin verdict over the whole finished branch, then on your go close it: promote what you name — the decision records, the glossary, the gotchas — report the leftovers, archive the change doc, push the branch and open its pull request.

name: dw-layer
description: ユーザーが Codex で $dw-layer / $dw-layer next / $dw-layer review / $dw-layer approve、 または Claude Code で /dw-layer / /dw-layer next / /dw-layer review / /dw-layer approve を入力したときに このスキルを有効化し、scripts/workflow.py を実行します。

name: dw-learn
description: Sintetiza decisoes duraveis, bugfixes, deviations e historico git em instincts atomicos ponderados por confianca que voce aprova; pode propor principios de constitution. On-demand e human-in-the-loop — sem observador sempre-ligado.

name: dw-llm-eval
description: Use when authoring or reviewing AI/LLM features (chat, RAG, agents, classifiers). Oracle ladder, reference dataset, judge calibration (Spearman ≥0.80), trajectory eval. Triggers on every AI code path.

name: dw-map
description: Use when ingesting raw artifacts, probes, requirements, or context at the start of any analysis. L0 layer — preserves full variance structure without averaging. Triggers when collecting raw data, exploring project state, or beginning any investigation.

name: dw-memory
description: Two-tier workflow memory (shared + per-task) with promotion test, so cross-task context survives without bloating files.

name: dw-minimalism
description: Evaluate a proposed abstraction, module or dependency for unnecessary complexity during planning or a focused over-engineering review.

name: dw-minimalism
description: Pre-generation YAGNI gate. Before writing new code, infra, or abstractions, climb the decision ladder (need it? reuse? stdlib? native? installed dep? one line?) at the active lite/full/ultra intensity. Triggers from /dw-run, /dw-plan, /dw-review and any "add X / build Y" intent.

name: dw-money-management-strategy
description: กลยุทธ์การบริหารเงิน (Money Management) และการบริหารความเสี่ยงสำหรับ DW

name: dw-new-project
description: Entrevista voce sobre stack e infra, depois faz scaffold de um monorepo com docker-compose para dev, .env, scripts, CI e rules seed.

name: dw-next
description: 从已验证的交付物推断八步流程进度并给出下一步。适用于会话开始、 compact 之后、或不确定当前做到哪一步时。

name: dw-next
description: Continue the change you are in the middle of, from where the last session had to leave it: catch up on where it stands and what is left, then build every unticked task, one commit each. Its state is read back from the doc, never from the conversation, so it survives a `/clear`.

name: dw-next
description: Start from the Delivery Workbench status briefing and pick up the next story.

name: dw-note-manager
description: Use when a ready_for_note_manager handoff or clear direct note request is in hand and a bounded durable note create, update, or metadata change must be drafted or applied.

name: dw-opportunities
description: Escaneia o projeto instalado por oportunidades de produto, UX, automacao, refactor e seguranca, e roteia cada ideia para o proximo comando dw-* correto.

name: dw-pause
description: Trigger quando usuario diz "pausa o trabalho", "encerra a sessao" ou "salva onde paramos". Consolida pontas soltas, decisoes, bloqueios e todos em .dw/STATE.md para a proxima sessao retomar.

name: dw-performance-optimization
description: Step 7/8 性能优化：分析 ETL SQL 的分区裁剪、JOIN 策略、数据倾斜与 扫描预算，输出带证据级别的优化建议。适用于任务上线前或超时排查。

name: dw-phase
description: ユーザーが Codex で $dw-phase / $dw-phase next / $dw-phase review / $dw-phase approve、 または Claude Code で /dw-phase / /dw-phase next / /dw-phase review / /dw-phase approve を入力したときに このスキルを有効化し、scripts/workflow.py を実行します。

name: dw-phase-light
description: ユーザーが Codex で $dw-phase-light / $dw-phase-light next / $dw-phase-light review / $dw-phase-light approve、 または Claude Code で /dw-phase-light / /dw-phase-light next / /dw-phase-light review / /dw-phase-light approve を入力したときに このスキルを有効化し、scripts/workflow.py を実行します。

name: dw-phase-parallel
description: dw-phase のレビュー済み phase 設計を入力に、依存関係のない phase を別 worktree・別 agent で並列実装し、phase ごとのレビューと PR 準備を管理します。

name: dw-phase-parallel-light
description: dw-phase のレビュー済み phase 設計を入力に、依存関係のない phase を別 worktree・別 agent で並列に一括実装し、自己レビューとテスト後に PR 準備状態にします。

name: dw-phase-tournament-flow
description: 要件、受入条件、blackbox リスクテスト設計、phase 分割、依存関係、 並列実装、必要な tournament、検証、統合までを単独で管理する delivery workflow。既存 workflow skill は使わず、review 系 skill だけを必要に応じて 呼び出す。既存 phase 設計をこの flow の成果物へ移行するときにも使う。

name: dw-pim-completeness
description: Configure PIM completion rules, scoring, automatic query movement, and missing-field enrichment. Triggers: assign rules, calculate completeness, enrich query results. Non-triggers: manual states or transitions -> dw-pim-workflow; schema -> dw-pim-modelling.

name: dw-pim-localization
description: Manage Dynamicweb 10 product translations across EcomLanguages. Triggers: localize product data, EcomLanguage setup, AreaCopy language layers. Non-triggers: page translation -> dw-content-localization; product structure -> dw-pim-modelling.

name: dw-pim-migrate-dw9
description: Migrate DW9 product structure and catalog data into DW10 PIM. Triggers: DW9 product export, map groups to Data Models, 0 warehouse shops or memberships. Non-triggers: Data Model design -> dw-pim-modelling; platform upgrade -> dw-setup-upgrade.

name: dw-pim-modelling
description: Model PIM Data Models, fields, folders, products, and variants. Triggers: global vs category fields, category groups, variant options or combinations, create or clone products. Non-triggers: workflow -> dw-pim-workflow; completeness -> dw-pim-completeness.

name: dw-pim-workflow
description: Configure manual PIM workflows with named states, transitions, editorial handoffs, and notifications. Triggers: create workflow states or transitions. Non-triggers: completeness-driven automatic movement -> dw-pim-completeness; schema -> dw-pim-modelling.

name: dw-plan
description: Trigger quando usuario tem ideia de feature e precisa spec + arquitetura + tasks. Roda PRD → TechSpec → Tasks sequencial. Stages: prd / techspec / tasks; --from techspec; --council.

name: dw-plan
description: 规划阶段：质询需求，冻结 SPEC。先询问是否有参考文档，调用 grill-with-docs/grill-me，然后 to-spec 产出 SPEC.md。

name: dw-post-merge-verification-skill
description: Verify that a merged PR actually changed production behavior, instead of trusting green CI. Runs what it can verify locally, queries the success metric through read-only APM/analytics tools, hands the dev a pasteable checklist for what it cannot reach, then rules the fix confirmed, no-effect, or inconclusive against the metric fixed at plan time. Use after a merge - "verify the fix landed", "did the fix actually work in prod", "post-merge check", "check prod impact", or `/dw-post-merge [PR URL]`. Touches production only through read-only observability queries.

name: dw-pr-ready-skill
description: Keep a single GitHub pull request ready for review by watching comments, CI, review state, draft state, merge queue, and safe branch updates. Use when the user provides a full PR URL and asks to babysit, keep green, keep ready for review, or maintain a PR until mergeable.

name: dw-prd
description: AI 协助产出 PRD。当用户要写/生成 PRD、把需求或想法整理成产品需求文档、做需求立项、把脑子里的功能变更落成可评审的 PRD，或提到'帮我写个 PRD / 生成需求文档 / 把这个需求写成 PRD / 需求文档怎么写 / 梳理需求 / 把需求写清楚'，或用英文说 write a PRD、draft a PRD、product requirements document、requirements doc 时使用。已有 PRD 且要做技术设计 / Overview / spec / 写代码时不要用本 skill，用 dw-workflow（改 PRD 本身仍用本 skill）。采用批量提问（非一问一答）分批澄清目标/非目标/现状/边界/验收，按变更PRD·轻量Issue·整品PRD 三类模板成稿；涉及用户可见 UI 新增/调整时，必须参考现有 UI 样式并产出独立 HTML 高保真交互原型。产物可直接作为 dw-workflow Step 1 的输入。

name: dw-prose
description: 规范文本、文档、注释与提示词的写作标准：删改前保住每条命题、各类文本必须写什么、只写现状不写来历、清理推理过程残留。写或改 spec、skill 文档、README、代码注释、卡片、提示词、报错文案时用；精简文档、压缩体积、review 文字质量、清掉'此前/不再/本次改动'这类叙述、判断一段注释该不该留时同样用。文档放哪个目录、何时归档用 dw-doc-governance；skill 的结构与 description 怎么设计用 skill-principle。

name: dw-prune
description: Walk `.ai/backlog/` and decide every entry out loud: drop what is stale or already done, do what is cheap and unblocked, bundle what ships with a cousin, leave the rest. Explicit-invoke only.

name: dw-qa
description: Trigger quando usuario quer validar comportamento alem de unit tests. Mode-aware (UI / API / --ai / --uat). --fix entra no loop iterativo QA + fix-retest. --bugfix <slug> aponta para uma entrada em .dw/bugfixes/.

name: dw-query
description: 使用自然语言查询 GIL 数仓数据。支持学生学习行为分析、答题效果分析、能量发放分析等场景。当用户询问学生、答题、学习进度、能量、知识点掌握度等数据时使用。

name: dw-redesign-ui
description: Audita uma pagina frontend, propoe direcoes de design que voce escolhe, e entrega o redesign.

name: dw-refactor
description: Audita um target por oportunidades de refactor usando o protocolo refactor-audit, smells Fowler, deep-modules e gates de teste preservando comportamento.

name: dw-render-razor
description: Build Dynamicweb 10 template hierarchies and Razor patterns. Triggers: Files/Templates/Designs, Razor syntax, render surfaces. Non-triggers: ViewModels -> dw-render-viewmodels; TemplateTags -> dw-render-templatetags; item types -> dw-content-modelling.

name: dw-render-templatetags
description: Access Dynamicweb 10 content properties directly with TemplateTags. Triggers: TemplateTags syntax, tags in templates, direct property access. Non-triggers: ViewModel rendering -> dw-render-viewmodels; template structure or Razor -> dw-render-razor.

name: dw-render-viewmodels
description: Fetch and shape content with Dynamicweb 10 ViewModels. Triggers: ViewModel properties or patterns, data shaping, when to use the C# API. Non-triggers: TemplateTags -> dw-render-templatetags; template structure or Razor -> dw-render-razor.

name: dw-requirement-analysis
description: Step 1/8 数仓需求分析：解读 PRD、梳理字段口径草稿、探索上游表结构、 输出待确认问题清单。适用于接到新数仓需求需要结构化拆解时。

name: dw-resume
description: Trigger quando usuario diz "retoma", "onde paramos?" ou comeca sessao num projeto com .dw/STATE.md existente. Le STATE.md, apresenta TLDR e sugere proximo comando dw-*.

name: dw-review
description: 上线前 SQL/契约评审清单：字段口径比对、注释三段式、生命周期、 分区策略、金额单位一致性。适用于提 PR 前自查或人肉评审辅助。
allowed_tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash(dw lint:*), Bash(dw contract:*), Bash(dw check:*)

name: dw-review
description: Trigger quando usuario pede pra revisar codigo, checar qualidade ou validar prontidao pra PR. Default roda L2 (cobertura PRD) + L3 (qualidade). Flags --coverage-only / --code-only / --bugfix <slug>.

name: dw-review
description: 评审阶段：对照 SPEC 验收代码变更。支持单 Agent 自审或并行多 Agent 圆桌评审。

name: dw-review-gate
description: 编码完成后的代码评审门：定评审范围与积压通路，判本次改动触碰的对象面，由面推出评审轴，按参照物分组派子代理逐轴评审，处置 P0/P1，核销替换清单。写完代码要评审、'过一下评审门'、合并或开 PR 之前、改了 skill 文档或 docs 下现行文档之后、要登记或核销被取代的旧逻辑时用；评审子代理自己也加载本 skill。不做需求与 spec（用 dw-workflow），不判文档去留的规则本身（用 dw-doc-governance）。

name: dw-review-prs-skill
description: Review the pull requests waiting on you and leave every finding as an UNSUBMITTED [dev-review-ai] review, so nothing reaches the author until you submit it yourself. Starts by reading what you already drafted, what you already posted, and what every other reviewer and bot has said, then reports the PRs still missing your draft with links. Use when the user asks "review the PRs I was asked to review", "what PRs are waiting on me", "draft my review comments", "review my review queue", or invokes /dw-review-prs.

name: dw-review-rigor
description: Five rules for review output — dedupe, severity-order, verify intent, skip linter noise, prefer signal over volume.

name: dw-run
description: Trigger quando usuario quer executar tasks. Default roda todas pendentes em ordem de dependencia; 'run <task-id>' roda uma; 'run --resume' continua plan interrompido.

name: dw-runbook-skill
description: Memoize a recurring multi-step shell workflow into a saved "runbook" — one command that any agent runs once, cached and queued so parallel agents stay isolated, that cleans up after itself. Use when a workflow keeps getting re-derived ("run the ci/lint/test checks", "run lint on the diff vs master", "how do we run the tests here", "set up a runbook for X", "promote this to a runbook", "cache this workflow as a command", "do we have a runbook for Y"), or when several agents need to run checks against the same repo without stepping on each other. First time a workflow is met, do it and capture…

name: dw-scope
description: Hold one scope conversation and draft one inert Delivery Workbench setup proposal.

name: dw-search-first
description: Research-before-building protocol for dependencies, integrations, MCP servers, libraries, and reusable skills.

name: dw-search-indexing
description: Build Dynamicweb 10 Lucene indexes and repository or PIM queries. Triggers: builders, instances, analyzers, boosts, scoring, ProductsFrontend, empty or overbroad query. Non-triggers: PIM modelling -> dw-pim-modelling; completeness -> dw-pim-completeness.

name: dw-secure-audit
description: Security Gate: OWASP + Semgrep SAST (diff) + gitleaks secrets + Trivy SCA/IaC + lockfile + supply-chain + outdated. Rigoroso: secrets/CRITICAL/HIGH bloqueiam. Auto-invocado por /dw-review e /dw-generate-pr, fase explicita no /dw-autopilot, e executavel standalone.

name: dw-self-test
description: Step 4/8 数仓自测：以隔离上下文执行 23 项标准自测并只回收摘要， 防止大量检查输出污染主对话。适用于 ETL 完成后验证数据质量。
allowed_tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash(dw lint:*), Bash(dw check:*)

name: dw-setup-cli
description: Deploy DW10 add-ins and Files content with the dw CLI. Triggers: dw install/files, DLL/NuGet upload, templates, archive export, recycle, API-key auth, silently skipped imports. Platform upgrades -> dw-setup-upgrade.

name: dw-setup-cli
description: Operate a Dynamicweb 10 solution with the `dw` CLI — install `.dll`/`.nupkg` add-ins, upload and update Files-archive content, export the archive, trigger a recycle, and prove the change landed. Triggers: deploy or install an add-in, `dw install`, `dw files`, upload or update templates, export a solution's files, trigger a recycle, API-key auth for the CLI, `dw install` reported success but nothing changed, an import that silently skipped, deciding whether a task belongs to the CLI or the Dynamicweb MCP server. Non-triggers: upgrading a solution's platform version -> dw-setup-upgrade; connect…

name: dw-setup-config
description: Configure DW10 environments and connections. Triggers: GlobalSettings, appsettings.json, environment variables, connection strings, SMTP, log retention, go-live settings. Fresh install -> dw-setup-install.

name: dw-setup-install
description: Install Swift 2 on a fresh DW10 instance. Triggers: baseline database/files, initial MCP add-ins. Existing settings -> dw-setup-config; presales host/MCP/TLS scaffolding -> presales bundle.

name: dw-setup-upgrade
description: Upgrade Dynamicweb platform versions. Triggers: DW9-to-DW10 migration, DW10 minor upgrades, pre-upgrade checks. Product catalog migration -> dw-pim-migrate-dw9; fresh install -> dw-setup-install.

name: dw-shape
description: Turn a request, a backlog entry or a finished `dw-grill` conversation into the change doc: write a durable `CHANGE.md` under `.ai/work/` with the goal, the decisions taken, a task checklist and anchors in real files; one per goal, never per shippable piece, depth scales with size, and in its own worktree when you ask for one.

name: dw-ship
description: Merge the landed change and leave nothing behind: settle the PR's checks, squash-merge it, tear down the worktree and branch, and pull the default branch. Explicit-invoke only.

name: dw-silent-failure
description: Checklist for finding swallowed errors, dangerous fallbacks, and lost failure context during review or bugfixes.

name: dw-simplification
description: Use when simplifying code. Chesterton's Fence (WHY first), behavior-preserving refactor, complexity metrics, deep-modules analysis. Triggers from /dw-review, /dw-refactor, and /dw-brainstorm refactor-audit.

name: dw-skill-authoring
description: Author, edit, and register skills in this repository — the frontmatter contract, naming, area taxonomy, length budgets, body voice, validation, manifest regeneration, and the PR workflow. Triggers: add a new skill, edit or restructure an existing SKILL.md, write or split a references/ file, register a skill in a bundle, fix a validator warning, manifest drift in CI, prepare a skills-repo PR. Non-triggers: folding a demo-build learning back into a skill -> skills/dw-demo-foldback/SKILL.md; consuming a skill to build a Dynamicweb solution -> the dw-* skills themselves.

name: dw-skill-authoring-skill
description: Principles, a checklist, and a failure-mode table for authoring reliable Agent Skills — naming, description, progressive disclosure, scripts vs. prose. Invoked by name.

name: dw-skill-eval-analyze
description: 启动技能评测的分析阶段。读取被测技能文件，运行静态分析脚本，对 5 个维度做语义分析，向用户收集评测上下文，最终生成 skill-analysis.yaml 作为后续评测步骤的基础。

name: dw-skill-eval-build
description: 当 skill-analysis.yaml 存在时，与用户协作构建测试集。按四层覆盖（正常路径、边界、对抗、压力）生成测试用例，验证后产出 testset.yaml。

name: dw-skill-eval-report
description: 当 scores.yaml 存在时，生成人类可读的评测报告。包含跨模型对比矩阵、关键发现（引用具体用例和 transcript）、改进建议（定位到被测技能 SKILL.md 具体位置），产出 report.md。

name: dw-skill-eval-run
description: 当 testset.yaml 存在时，跨模型执行测试用例。Claude 模型通过 Subagent 隔离执行（不传递期望结果），非 Claude 模型通过 AgentScope run_single_case() 执行。收集 transcript 并保存 execution_summary.yaml。

name: dw-skill-eval-score
description: 当 transcripts/ 目录存在时，对执行结果进行三层评分。规则层（API 正确性等）+ LLM 评委层（语义评估）+ 统计层（一致性、pass@k），含禁止 API 一票否决和校准检查，产出 scores.yaml。

name: dw-skill-eval-verify
description: 评测完成后验证质量（--quality 模式：检查区分度、难度分布、评委一致性等 6 项指标），或修改技能后运行回归测试（--regression 模式：对比基线、检测回归、管理版本）。

name: dw-skill-health
description: Audita skills e agentes instalados por bloat, duplicacao, referencias quebradas e modulos sem uso.

name: dw-source-doc-lookup
description: Look up live DW10 documentation for feature behavior and configuration. Triggers: how-to questions, exact field/setting/macro/tag/API names, unexpected behavior. C# internals -> dw-source-explorer.

name: dw-source-explorer
description: Find Dynamicweb API internals and extension points from NuGet package metadata, the release changelog and the public GitHub repositories. Triggers: find classes/methods, understand implementation before coding. MCP tool implementation -> dw-extend-mcp-tools.

name: dw-source-grounding
description: Use when citing frameworks or libraries. Detect → Fetch → Implement → Cite with [source: url, version, retrieved]. Triggers on every framework decision in techspec, deps audit, research.

name: dw-sql-reference
description: 数仓 SQL 规范参考（引擎差异、政策规则、正反例）。Claude 在读写 SQL 文件时按需加载，不给用户手动调用。

name: dw-sr
description: Step 6/8 StarRocks 导入：按契约与 MaxCompute 表结构生成 SR 建表语句、 同步配置与风险分析。适用于数据需要从 MaxCompute 同步到 SR 时。

name: dw-story-done
description: Prove, flip, and ship the current story through the PMO gate.

name: dw-subtask-complete
description: Registra handoff estruturado do subagente com resultado, arquivos, decisoes, riscos, verificacao e bloqueios.

name: dw-subtask-resume
description: Consome handoffs pendentes de subagentes, resume para o parent e arquiva os pacotes locais.

name: dw-subtask-start
description: Cria um input packet minimo para subagente sem injetar transcript bruto do parent.

name: dw-swift-building
description: Customize an existing Swift 2 site while preserving its page shell. Triggers: rebrand or repurpose Swift, update area settings, navigation, category pages, or item values. Non-triggers: new install -> dw-setup-install; migration -> dw-swift-migrate-site.

name: dw-swift-migrate-site
description: Migrate any existing website or webshop to a Truvio Commerce Swift 2 site: content, PIM catalog import, and a review loop. Triggers: migrate, convert, or replatform a site to Dynamicweb or Swift 2. Swift 1 site kept as it is -> dw-swift-upgrade.

name: dw-swift-page-blocks
description: Reference Swift 2 rows, paragraph types, variants, fields, color schemes, and page tools. Triggers: Swift layout or component vocabulary before page work. Non-triggers: item schemas -> dw-content-modelling; page writes -> dw-swift-page-design.

name: dw-swift-page-design
description: Design and build one Swift 2 page from a screenshot, mockup, URL, or brief. Triggers: recreate a page look, campaign page, landing page. Non-triggers: whole-site rebuild -> dw-swift-migrate-site; faithful Swift 1 port -> dw-swift-upgrade.

name: dw-swift-upgrade
description: Upgrade a Swift 1 site to Swift 2 as it is: a faithful port of its pages with layout and structure preserved. Triggers: upgrade Swift 1 to Swift 2, Swift v1 migration, 1:1 layout port, faithful Swift conversion. Non-triggers: redesign, non-Swift source or catalog -> dw-swift-migrate-site; new page -> dw-swift-page-design.

name: dw-technical-design
description: Step 2/8 数仓技术设计：OneData 建模、表名粒度/主键/分区设计、 字段类型约束沉淀到表契约。适用于需求分析完成后进入建模阶段。
allowed_tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Write, Bash(dw contract:*)

name: dw-testing-discipline
description: Use when authoring, reviewing, or debugging tests. Six core rules, 25 anti-patterns, 6 agent guardrails, flaky discipline. Triggers on every test diff, /dw-qa, or test-writing session.

name: dw-ticket-manager-skill
description: Run an accepted set of settled Jira tickets across the repos they touch until draft PRs exist or you stop; invoke /dw-ticket-manager [starting ticket key].

name: dw-trading-thailand-strategy

description: 对医学研究原始数据做只读结构与质量检查，先形成可审阅的统计分析计划，获用户明确批准后再生成并运行本地 R 或既定统计代码，交付脚本、日志、诊断和可追溯结果。当用户要求分析 CSV、Excel、SPSS、Stata 等患者级 数据或拟定统计方案时使用；仅判断数据能支持什么问题交给 dyz-med-data-adequacy，解释既有结果交给 dyz-med-interpret，检验既有结果稳健性则交给 dyz-med-sensitivity。 Use for biostatistical analysis planning and approved R or other local statistical execution.

name: dyz-med-cnki
description: 为医学主题设计并执行可复现的中英文文献检索，产出查询式、检索记录和去重后的候选文献池。当用户要“查文献” “覆盖 PubMed 和中文来源”或核实某研究问题的文献范围时使用；本技能负责发现与记录，深度精读交给 dyz-med-key-literature，系统综述的正式筛选与纳入流程交给 dyz-med-screening-pipeline。无法直接访问知网、万方或 维普时只能提供 discovery_only 线索，不得声称完成了数据库检索或全文获取。 Use for PubMed and Chinese medical literature search; database execution requires access.

name: dyz-med-data-adequacy
description: 在统计分析和论文写作前检查医学数据能否支持计划问题、模型和论断，产出数据充分性报告、异常清单、待临床 确认问题及可接受的分析范围。当用户问“这些数据够不够”“能支持什么结论”或准备分析前需要数据把关时使用； 实际建模交给 dyz-med-analyze，已有统计结果的临床解释交给 dyz-med-interpret，不能据此承诺期刊或分区。 Use to assess medical research data adequacy before statistical analysis.

name: dyz-med-deai
description: 在不改变医学事实和证据的前提下，改善医学论文中模板化、重复、空泛或机械的语言，使表达更自然、具体且 符合作者语气。当用户说文字“太像 AI”“太模板化”“不自然”或要求医学学术语言自然化时使用；本 Skill 不用于规避 AI 检测，不判断文本作者身份，也不删除必要的 AI 使用披露。 Use to improve repetitive academic prose while preserving facts and disclosure; not detector evasion.

name: dyz-med-discussion
description: 基于已核实结果、研究设计和文献证据撰写或修订医学论文讨论部分，覆盖主要发现、与既有证据的比较、合理 解释、局限性、适用性和结论边界。当用户明确要写讨论、解释结果或修复过度声称时使用；不改写统计结果， 不把引用次数当作证据质量，也不编造机制或未来研究样本量。 Use to draft or revise medical discussions, evidence comparisons and limitations.

name: dyz-med-evidence-audit
description: 核对医学稿件中的关键论断是否被所引文献、指南、用户数据或明确标注的推断真正支持，输出逐条论断—证据 矩阵、来源定位和待处理问题。当用户要求检查引用是否对题、论断有没有依据、知识缺口是否夸大或结论是否 超出证据时使用；不代替完整同行评议、报告规范检查或参考文献排版。 Use to audit manuscript claims against cited literature and study evidence.

name: dyz-med-export
description: 将已完成的医学稿件及其参考文献、表格和图片整理为目标期刊要求的 Word、PDF 或其他交付格式，并核对 跨节数字、引用和图表链接。当用户要求导出 DOCX、合并稿件、套用期刊格式或制作可审阅文件时使用； 不改动原始稿件、不假设本地工具存在，也不把导出等同于投稿或科学内容通过审核。 Use to assemble basic DOCX review drafts; advanced formatting requires suitable external tools.

name: dyz-med-figures-tables
description: 规划、生成和核对医学论文的结果表格与统计图，建立数据来源清单，检查正文、图表和已执行分析输出的一致性， 并生成可审阅的标题、图注和脚注。当用户问“需要哪些图表”“帮我做森林图/Table 1”或要求核对图文数字时 使用；CONSORT、STROBE、PRISMA 等流程图由 dyz-med-flowchart 专门处理。 Use for medical manuscript tables, statistical figures and text–figure consistency.

name: dyz-med-flowchart
description: 从可追溯的研究流程计数生成并核对随机试验、观察性研究、系统综述或范围综述流程图，交付结构化计数、 Mermaid/可渲染图稿、图注和流程叙述。当用户要求 CONSORT、STROBE、PRISMA 或 PRISMA-ScR 流程图时使用； 文献去重与筛选由 dyz-med-screening-pipeline 负责，其他统计图表由 dyz-med-figures-tables 负责。 Use for PRISMA, CONSORT and observational study flow diagrams from traceable counts.

name: dyz-med-guideline
description: 按当前适用的医学研究报告规范逐条核对稿件，标记 COVERED、PARTIAL、MISSING、NOT_APPLICABLE，并给出 可定位的修改建议。当用户明确要检查 CONSORT、STROBE、PRISMA、STARD、CARE、TRIPOD、ARRIVE、SPIRIT 等规范符合性时使用；笼统稿件诊断、论断证据核查和模拟审稿分别交给相应技能，本技能不出具合规认证。 Use to check applicable medical reporting guidelines including STROBE, CONSORT and PRISMA.

name: dyz-med-ideate
description: 把尚未成形的临床观察、兴趣领域、导师方向或数据库线索，转化为结构化且可验证的医学研究问题，并完成 PICO、PECO、PICOS、FINER、机制层级和初步文献缺口判断。当用户说“不知道研究什么”“这个想法能否 做成课题”“想找一个可执行选题”时使用；已有明确问题和数据需要立项时转交 dyz-med-init，已有稿件时不要使用。 Use for clinical research ideation, PICO questions and feasibility exploration.

name: dyz-med-init
description: 为已有明确研究问题、研究设计和数据或结果的医学论文创建写作项目，识别研究类型、匹配当前报告规范、检查 可行性与关键风险，并生成最小 IMRaD 骨架。当用户说“研究已经做完，准备开始写论文”或要初始化新论文项目 时使用；尚未形成研究问题时先用 dyz-med-ideate，已有稿件需要评估时转 dyz-med-manuscript-diagnose。 Use to initialize a medical manuscript project from an established study.

name: dyz-med-interpret
description: 把既有医学统计结果与预先规定、来源可追溯的临床重要阈值放在同一尺度上，区分统计证据、效应大小和临床 重要性，产出逐结局解释表及谨慎措辞。当用户问“显著但有临床意义吗”“区间是否排除重要获益或伤害”时使用； 不负责重新建模或计算原始数据，也不替代 dyz-med-sensitivity 的稳健性分析。 Use to interpret existing statistical results and clinical importance without rerunning models.

name: dyz-med-introduction
description: 基于已确认的研究问题、论证地图和已核实文献撰写或修订医学论文引言，形成临床背景、已有证据、具体知识 缺口与研究目的之间的清晰逻辑。当用户明确要写引言或修复引言逻辑时使用；不负责讨论、结果解释或整篇统稿。 Use to draft or revise a medical manuscript introduction and research rationale.

name: dyz-med-journal-finder
description: 根据医学稿件的主题、文章类型、研究设计、目标读者、开放获取预算和时间要求，核实候选期刊的当前范围、 投稿要求与费用并给出分层短名单。当用户问“适合投什么期刊”“这本期刊匹配吗”或需要改投梯队时使用； 不承诺录用，不凭记忆提供影响因子、接受率、审稿周期或版面费。 Use for medical journal selection based on verified scope, requirements and fees.

name: dyz-med-key-literature
description: 从已有候选文献池中筛选前沿、奠基、指南、系统综述、矛盾证据和本土关键文献，完成全文级结构化精读并形成 可复用的文献地图、单篇简报和证据综合。当用户要“精读几篇关键论文”“找绕不开的文献”或核对与结论矛盾的 研究时使用；从零检索文献应先用 dyz-med-cnki，只有摘要或题录时不得声称已完成深度精读。 Use for critical appraisal and synthesis of available full-text medical literature.

name: dyz-med-manuscript-diagnose
description: 对用户已有的医学稿件、部分草稿、摘要、表格、拒稿信或审稿意见做只读现状诊断，给出材料清单、当前阶段、 主要科学与写作风险、投稿准备度和优先级。当用户想先知道“这篇稿子现在有什么问题、下一步怎么走”时使用； 本 Skill 不直接改写稿件，具体修订交给 dyz-med-revision 或分节 Skill。 Use for read-only manuscript assessment and revision priorities.

name: dyz-med-mechanism
description: 检验和升级医学研究问题的机制与因果逻辑，支持机制链检查、临床与基础双向转化、AI 模型解释、研究再设计、 因果图和中介分析方案。当用户询问“机制是否说得通”“能否从相关性升级”“如何构建因果图或中介路径”时 使用；不负责从零选题，也不把关联、特征重要性或预测性能解释为因果机制。 Use to examine causal reasoning, mechanism hypotheses and study logic.

name: dyz-med-methods
description: 根据研究方案、实际执行记录和统计分析计划撰写或修订医学论文方法部分。当用户需要把研究设计、研究对象、 变量测量、偏倚控制、统计方法及适用的伦理注册信息写成可复核正文时使用；不替用户设计未确认的方法， 不运行统计分析，也不编造批件号、日期、软件版本或数据共享安排。 Use to write methods sections from actual study procedures and approved analysis plans.

name: dyz-med-orchestrator
description: 读取医学论文项目状态与现有工件，生成当前进度地图、关键风险和一个最合适的下一步建议。当用户问“现在 到哪一步”“下一步做什么”“从哪里开始”或需要澄清多种医学任务的选择时使用；状态查询只推荐下一步， 明确的自然语言任务直接匹配最窄职责 Skill，无需说出技能名；不自动串联后续阶段或宣告稿件可投稿。 Use to review medical research workflow progress and recommend the next task.

name: dyz-med-passport
description: 供医学论文工作流内部读取和更新项目状态文件，记录已确认事实、产出版本、来源、开放问题、人工批准和质量 检查历史。当其他 dyz-med-* Skill 需要共享项目状态或避免重复询问时使用；用户想查看进度时优先使用 dyz-med-orchestrator。本 Skill 只记录已有事实，不作医学判断，也不把缺失字段自动填成已确认。 Use internally to maintain confirmed project facts, provenance and artifact versions.

name: dyz-med-registration
description: 从官方注册平台核实临床试验或其他研究的注册记录，并与方案、分析计划和稿件交叉检查注册时间、研究设计、 结局、样本量及结果报告差异。当用户提供 NCT、ChiCTR、ISRCTN、UMIN 等注册号，询问是否前瞻注册、是否 存在结局切换或需要注册声明时使用；报告规范的全面检查交给 dyz-med-guideline，未查到原始记录时不得生成 确定性注册声明。 Use to check trial registration records against protocols and manuscripts.

name: dyz-med-results
description: 把已核实的统计输出、表格和图转写为医学论文结果部分，保持样本量、效应量、置信区间、P 值、模型及分析 层级可追溯。当用户需要撰写或修订结果正文、图表引用或数值一致性时使用；不运行新分析、不补造缺失数字， 也不承担讨论解释。 Use to write results sections while preserving verified effect estimates and numerical provenance.

name: dyz-med-review
description: 对接近投稿状态的医学稿件做五个视角的模拟审稿：证据、方法统计、伦理合规、临床领域与期刊编辑，并汇总 为定位明确的 PASS、REVISE 或 REJECT 建议。当用户要求投稿前全面把关、模拟同行评议或评估拒稿风险时 使用；这是决策支持，不是真实同行评议，也不会自动修改、导出或投稿。 Use for simulated pre-submission peer review and located revision recommendations.

name: dyz-med-revision
description: 修订已有医学稿件或逐条回应编辑和审稿人意见，覆盖语言、结构、科学表述、改投适配和拒稿后恢复，并保留 可追溯的修改记录。当用户明确要求修改稿件、回复审稿意见或按新期刊重整时使用；先给修订计划，文字和 格式修改可在授权范围内执行，涉及新数据、重分析、伦理、作者或其他源事实时必须先获得确认。 Use for manuscript revision, response to reviewers and journal resubmission preparation.

name: dyz-med-screening-pipeline
description: 管理系统综述、Meta 分析或范围综述从检索导入、保守去重、标题摘要与全文筛选，到研究/报告关联、数据提取 和 PRISMA 计数的可审计证据链。当用户要执行文献筛选、记录纳排理由或准备证据合成输入时使用；研究问题与 方案设计不是本技能的主要任务，流程图交给 dyz-med-flowchart，原始研究数据统计与合并模型交给 dyz-med-analyze。 Use for systematic review and meta-analysis screening, extraction and PRISMA counts.

name: dyz-med-sensitivity
description: 围绕既有医学研究结果的具体不确定性，规划、执行或记录替代模型、缺失数据、偏倚假设、分析人群和研究纳入 变化，产出可追溯的稳健性比较与局限性说明。当用户问“结果稳不稳”“换假设会不会变”或明确要求敏感性分析 时使用；原始主分析交给 dyz-med-analyze，临床重要性解释交给 dyz-med-interpret。 Use for approved sensitivity analyses and robustness comparisons of existing findings.

name: dyz-med-submit
description: 根据目标期刊当前要求准备医学论文投稿包，包括投稿信、题名页、作者贡献、利益冲突、数据可用性及其他 指定附件。当用户要求准备投稿材料、cover letter 或投稿前清单时使用；默认只生成本地文件，绝不自动 上传、发送、点击提交或创建外部数据仓库，任何外部提交动作都需要用户另行明确授权并最终确认。 Use to prepare local cover letters and journal submission packages; external submission needs authorization.

name: dyz-med-translate
description: 在中文与英文之间忠实翻译医学论文、摘要、投稿材料或审稿回复，统一医学术语，同时逐项保护数字、单位、 统计量、引用、伦理与注册信息。当用户明确要求中译英、英译中或制作双语版本时使用；不负责大范围内容 重构，也不会为了“符合学术写作”补造原文缺失的效应量、事实或引用。 Use for Chinese–English medical translation with numerical, citation and terminology preservation.

name: dyz-med-write
description: 在用户明确要求时，把已确认的医学研究材料一次性整合为完整初稿，或对已完成的各章节做全文连贯性与 一致性修订。当用户说“一次性写成全文”“合成一稿”或“全文统稿”时使用；默认分节写作仍由 dyz-med-introduction、dyz-med-methods、dyz-med-results、dyz-med-discussion 和 dyz-med-abstract 分别负责。 Use for explicitly requested full manuscript drafts or coherence editing across completed sections.

name: dyz-med-writing-plan
description: 在医学论文成文前，把已确认的研究问题、研究设计、统计结果和文献证据整理成全文论证地图与段落级写作计划。 当用户想先理清论文逻辑、章节任务、论断边界或证据分配时使用；不代替分节撰写、统计分析或文献真实性核查。 Use for medical manuscript argument maps and paragraph-level writing plans.

name: dyz-patent
description: 从技术材料开展专利发明挖掘、检索策略、现有技术比较、交底、权利要求和说明书起草或核稿；支持地区、外观/GUI及专业图示任务分流。程序、FTO和许可转dyz-procedure。

name: dyz-procedure
description: 处理专利公开/申请支持、优先权与期限、OA审查答复、后续申请和救济，以及侵权/FTO、无效、设计绕开、许可尽调、SEP、专利全景和维持预算的内部分析；软件版权或标准自身程序转对应技能。

name: dyz-rendering
description: 审阅专利、软件版权或技术标准稿件的图文对应、分页裁切、隐藏内容、屏幕/打印表现与修复证据；支持SVG/Markdown/文本预览及Word/PDF检查规划，不替代专业内容判断或官方格式验收。

name: dyz-software
description: 准备软件著作权/软件版权材料：软件与版本范围、组件权属、源码选材和秘密处理、使用/设计说明、一致性审阅，以及补正变更、跨地区材料和版权争议证据；不用于专利性判断或普通代码调试。

name: dyz-standards
description: 研究或编写技术标准的范围、术语、条款与验证矩阵，处理意见、送审准备、修订、国际提案/采用及公开前IP交接；区分组织程序与技术判断，不用于泛称“标准格式”的普通润色或专利必要性认定。

name: dyz-workbench
description: 将专利、软件版权与技术标准的多业务请求或中断任务转成最小问诊、材料权限检查、专业分流和版本交接；专业明确的单步任务直接用对应Skill。共享CLI仅用于本地合成演练。

name: dyzo-task
description: Write, rewrite, or comment on Dyzo tasks in a fixed, concise format. Use whenever creating a Dyzo task, updating a task description, tidying/cleaning up an existing task, or adding a task comment via the dyzo MCP tools (create_tasks, update_task, add_task_comment). Learns each user's own writing voice from their past Dyzo tasks on first use. Also use when the user says "add this to Dyzo", "make a task for…", "log this", "tidy task DW-123", or "learn my voice".

name: dz-aegis-agent
description: "정합성 검증" · "AEGIS cross-check" · "일관성 검증" · "산출물 교차 검증" 트리거. 다중 산출물 (요구사항·화면설계·개발 계획(D-06)·개발설계(D-08)·구현·검수) 의 cross-check + 일관성 검증 + 품질 게이트를 수행한다. Forge 16 업무별 서브에이전트 중 정합성 검증 영역 담당.

name: dz-agent-dispatch
description: This skill should be used when the user asks "에이전트 투입해줘", "ORACLE 한테 조사시켜", "CIPHER 요구사항 분석 시작", "AEGIS 정합성 검증해", "병렬로 돌려", "팀원 배치", or when dispatching subagents for parallel or sequential tasks. name: edges-error-handling

name: edges-get-workspace

name: edges-get-workspace-consumption

name: edges-getting-started

name: edges-identity-guide
description: Choose the right identity mode for Edges API calls. name: edges-linkedin-accept-invitation
description: Accept a single LinkedIn connection invitation via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to accept a pending connection request. Requires a connected identity (direct mode).

name: edges-linkedin-accept-invitations
description: Accept multiple LinkedIn connection invitations in batch via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to accept several pending connection requests at once. Requires a connected identity (direct mode).

name: edges-linkedin-comment-post
description: Comment on a LinkedIn post via the Edges API. This skill should be used when the user wants to comment on a post, add a reply to LinkedIn content, or engage with someone's post with a written response. Requires a connected identity (direct mode).

name: edges-linkedin-connect-profile
description: Send a connection request on LinkedIn via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to connect with someone on LinkedIn, send a connection invitation, add someone to their LinkedIn network, or send a connection request with an optional note. Requires a connected LinkedIn identity (direct mode). Part of the outreach sequence: visit → connect → message. For SN-based connection requests, use salesnavigator-connect-profile.

name: edges-linkedin-extract-company
description: Extract LinkedIn company profile data via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to get company information, enrich a company, extract company data from a LinkedIn URL, look up a company on LinkedIn, get company size, industry, website, description, funding, or employee count. Returns the linkedin_company_id needed for URL construction (content feeds, job searches, new hire monitoring, CURRENT_COMPANY/PAST_COMPANY filters). Cookieless (managed mode).

name: edges-linkedin-extract-company-affiliates
description: Extract company affiliates (subsidiaries and parent companies) from LinkedIn via the Edges API. This skill should be used when the user wants to find subsidiaries, parent companies, related entities, or corporate structure of a company. Cookieless (managed mode).

name: edges-linkedin-extract-company-employees-insights
description: Extract employee insights and headcount breakdown from a LinkedIn company page via the Edges API. This skill should be used when the user wants to see employee distribution by department, location, or school, analyze a company's workforce composition, or get headcount by function and seniority. Cookieless (managed mode).

name: edges-linkedin-extract-connections
description: Extract the full connections list from a LinkedIn identity's network via the Edges API. This skill should be used when the user wants to get all their LinkedIn connections, export their network, audit connection quality, or build a list of 1st-degree contacts. Requires a connected identity (direct mode). Supports incremental sync for monitoring new connections.

name: edges-linkedin-extract-contact
description: Extract contact information (email, phone, address) from a LinkedIn profile via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to get someone's contact details from their LinkedIn profile. Requires a connected LinkedIn identity (`identity_ids`). Does not support managed mode.

name: edges-linkedin-extract-conversations
description: Extract LinkedIn messaging conversations via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to list their LinkedIn message threads, check for replies in outreach, detect who replied by checking last_message sender, or audit messaging activity. Also use for sync-before-send — always extract conversations immediately before sending a message. Requires a connected identity (direct mode).

name: edges-linkedin-extract-event
description: Extract LinkedIn event details via the Edges API. This skill should be used when the user wants to get event information, see event description, organizer, date, or attendee count from a LinkedIn event URL. Cookieless (managed mode).

name: edges-linkedin-extract-event-attendees
description: Extract attendees registered for a LinkedIn event via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to get a list of people attending a LinkedIn event, build an attendee list, or prospect from event registrations. Cookieless (managed mode).

name: edges-linkedin-extract-followers
description: Extract the list of people following a LinkedIn profile via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to see who follows their profile, audit their follower base, or analyze follower quality. Requires a connected identity (direct mode). Supports incremental sync for monitoring new followers.

name: edges-linkedin-extract-group-members
description: Extract members of a LinkedIn group via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to get a list of people in a LinkedIn group, prospect from a group, or analyze group membership. Cookieless (managed mode).

name: edges-linkedin-extract-job
description: Extract details of a LinkedIn job posting via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to get job listing details including title, company, description, requirements, and location from a LinkedIn job URL. Cookieless (managed mode).

name: edges-linkedin-extract-licenses-certifications
description: Extract licenses and certifications from a LinkedIn profile via the Edges API. This skill should be used when the user wants to get someone's professional certifications, credentials, licenses, or accreditations listed on their LinkedIn profile. Cookieless (managed mode).

name: edges-linkedin-extract-messages
description: Extract messages from a LinkedIn conversation thread via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to read messages in a specific LinkedIn conversation, get the full message history of a thread, or check message content. Use edges-linkedin-extract-conversations first to list threads and get the thread URL. Requires a connected identity (direct mode).

name: edges-linkedin-extract-page-followers
description: Extract followers of a LinkedIn company page via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to get a list of people following a company page, audit company page followers, or prospect from a company's audience. Requires admin access to the company page (direct mode).

name: edges-linkedin-extract-people
description: Extract full LinkedIn profile data via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to get a LinkedIn profile, enrich a person, extract profile data from a LinkedIn URL, look up someone on LinkedIn, get professional information about a person, or retrieve a profile's headline, experience, education, or skills. This is the primary profile extraction action — use extract-people-experiences for complete job history beyond the last 5, and extract-contact for visible email/phone on the profile.

name: edges-linkedin-extract-people-comment-activity
description: Extract posts that a specific person COMMENTED ON via the Edges API. This returns posts where the person left a comment — their commenting activity, not comments on their posts. To get people who commented on a specific post, use edges-linkedin-extract-post-commenters instead. Cookieless (managed mode).

name: edges-linkedin-extract-people-educations
description: Extract education history from a LinkedIn profile via the Edges API. This skill should be used when the user wants to get someone's schools, degrees, fields of study, or education background. Cookieless (managed mode). Provides more detail than the education data returned by extract-people with sections: true.

name: edges-linkedin-extract-people-experiences
description: Extract complete work experience history from a LinkedIn profile via the Edges API. This skill should be used when the user needs full job history, wants all positions beyond the last 5 returned by extract-people, or needs to analyze someone's complete career trajectory. Cookieless (managed mode). Note: linkedin-extract-people only returns the last 5 experiences — use this skill for complete history paginated in chunks of 20.

name: edges-linkedin-extract-people-post-activity
description: Extract posts PUBLISHED BY a specific person on LinkedIn via the Edges API. This skill returns posts that the person authored — their own content feed. Do NOT use this for finding posts that mention someone — use edges-linkedin-search-content for that instead. Use when the user wants to see what someone has been posting, analyze their content strategy, or get their recent LinkedIn posts.

name: edges-linkedin-extract-people-reaction-activity
description: Extract posts that a specific person REACTED TO (liked) via the Edges API. This returns posts the person engaged with — their reaction history, not who reacted to their posts. To get people who liked a specific post, use edges-linkedin-extract-post-likers instead. Cookieless (managed mode).

name: edges-linkedin-extract-people-skills
description: Extract the full skills list with endorsement counts from a LinkedIn profile via the Edges API. This skill should be used when the user wants all skills for a person, needs endorsement data, or wants to analyze someone's technical competencies. Cookieless (managed mode). Note: linkedin-extract-people with skills: true only returns 1-2 main skills — use this skill for the complete list.

name: edges-linkedin-extract-post
description: Extract LinkedIn post details including content, engagement metrics, and author data via the Edges API. This skill should be used when the user wants to get a post's content, see reaction/comment/repost counts, analyze post engagement, or extract details from a LinkedIn post URL. Cookieless (managed mode).

name: edges-linkedin-extract-post-commenters
description: Extract people who commented on a LinkedIn post via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to get commenters on a specific post, build a list of engaged prospects, or analyze comment engagement. Live mode returns 20 per page (paginate). For full list without manual pagination, use async mode. Note: nested replies are not accessible. Cookieless (managed mode).

name: edges-linkedin-extract-post-likers
description: Extract people who liked a LinkedIn post via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to get likers on a specific post, build a list of engaged prospects, or analyze reaction engagement. Live mode returns 20 per page (paginate). For full list without manual pagination, use async mode. Cookieless (managed mode).

name: edges-linkedin-extract-post-reposters
description: Extract people who reposted a LinkedIn post via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to get people who shared a specific post, analyze repost engagement, or build a list from content sharers. Cookieless (managed mode).

name: edges-linkedin-extract-profile-viewers
description: Extract people who viewed your LinkedIn profile via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to see who viewed their profile, monitor profile visits, or identify warm leads who showed interest. Requires a connected identity (direct mode). Supports incremental sync.

name: edges-linkedin-extract-received-invitations
description: Extract pending inbound LinkedIn connection invitations via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to see who sent them connection requests, review pending invitations, or manage inbound connection requests. Requires a connected identity (direct mode).

name: edges-linkedin-extract-school-alumnis
description: Extract alumni from a LinkedIn school page via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to find graduates from a university, build an alumni list, or prospect by school network. Cookieless (managed mode).

name: edges-linkedin-extract-sent-invitations
description: Extract pending outbound LinkedIn connection invitations via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to see connection requests they have sent that are still pending, audit outreach pipeline, or find invitations to withdraw. Requires a connected identity (direct mode).

name: edges-linkedin-extract-similar-companies
description: Extract companies similar to a given company on LinkedIn via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to find competitors, discover companies in the same space, or expand a target account list. Cookieless (managed mode).

name: edges-linkedin-find-company-url
description: Find a company's LinkedIn page URL from their domain name or company name via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user has a domain (e.g. stripe.com) or company name and needs the verified LinkedIn URL. Always use this to resolve company URLs — never guess LinkedIn slugs. No LinkedIn identity required.

name: edges-linkedin-find-profile-url
description: Find a LinkedIn profile URL by name via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to find someone's LinkedIn profile from their name, resolve a person's name to a LinkedIn URL, look up a LinkedIn profile by full name, or do a quick person lookup without constructing a search URL. AI-powered lookup — simpler than search-people but less precise. No LinkedIn identity required. For more control over search results, use linkedin-search-people.

name: edges-linkedin-follow-profile
description: Follow a LinkedIn profile via the Edges API. This skill should be used when the user wants to follow someone on LinkedIn, subscribe to their content updates, or add a follow action to an outreach sequence. Requires a connected identity (direct mode).

name: edges-linkedin-inmail-profile
description: Send an InMail to a LinkedIn profile via the Edges API. This skill should be used when the user wants to send an InMail, message someone without being connected, or reach out to a non-connection via InMail credits. name: edges-linkedin-invite-event
description: Invite someone to a LinkedIn event via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to send event invitations on LinkedIn. Requires a connected identity (direct mode).

name: edges-linkedin-like-post
description: Like a LinkedIn post via the Edges API. This skill should be used when the user wants to like a post on LinkedIn, react to content, or engage with someone's post as part of an outreach warmup. Requires a connected identity (direct mode).

name: edges-linkedin-message-profile
description: Send a direct message to a LinkedIn connection via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to message someone on LinkedIn, send a DM, follow up with a connection, or send an outreach message. Target must be a 1st-degree connection — NOT_CONNECTED error if not. Always extract-conversations first (sync-before-send). Requires a connected identity (direct mode).

name: edges-linkedin-search-companies

For SN company search with more filters, use salesnavigator-search-companies. For resolving a company name or domain to a LinkedIn URL, use find-company-url.

name: edges-linkedin-search-company-employees
description: Search employees of a specific company on standard LinkedIn via the Edges API. Only use this standard LinkedIn version if the user explicitly asks for it. Before calling, resolve the company URL — do NOT guess URL slugs.

name: edges-linkedin-search-content
description: Search LinkedIn posts and articles by keyword via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to find posts about a topic, search LinkedIn content, find posts mentioning a person or company, monitor company mentions, or discover content by keyword. This is the right skill for "posts mentioning [someone]" — NOT extract-people-post-activity which returns posts published BY a person. Cookieless (managed mode).

name: edges-linkedin-search-events
description: Search for events on LinkedIn via the Edges API. This skill should be used when the user wants to find LinkedIn events by keyword, discover upcoming events, or search for events in a specific industry. Cookieless (managed mode).

name: edges-linkedin-search-groups
description: Search for groups on LinkedIn via the Edges API. This skill should be used when the user wants to find LinkedIn groups by topic, discover industry groups, or search for communities. Cookieless (managed mode).

name: edges-linkedin-search-people
description: Search for people on LinkedIn via the Edges API. name: edges-linkedin-search-schools

name: edges-linkedin-visit-company
description: Visit a company page on LinkedIn to leave a view trace via the Edges API. This does NOT extract company data — it only registers a page view. name: edges-linkedin-visit-profile

name: edges-recruiterlite-search-people
description: Search people via LinkedIn Recruiter Lite via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user specifically wants to use Recruiter Lite search. For general people search, prefer edges-salesnavigator-search-people which has broader access and richer data. Cookieless (managed mode).

description: Get employee count and headcount trends for a company via Sales Navigator and the Edges API. This skill should be used when the user wants to know how many employees a company has, track headcount growth, or get employee tenure data. Cookieless (managed mode).

description: Get employee distribution by department, seniority, and location via Sales Navigator and the Edges API. This skill should be used when the user wants to see workforce breakdown by function, analyze department sizes, or understand company org structure. Cookieless (managed mode).

name: edges-salesnavigator-extract-leads-list

name: edges-salesnavigator-search-companies
description: Search companies on Sales Navigator via the Edges API. name: edges-salesnavigator-search-company-employees

name: edges-salesnavigator-search-saved-companies

name: edges-salesnavigator-search-saved-people

name: edges-salesnavigator-visit-company
description: Visit a company page on Sales Navigator via the Edges API. Use this skill when the user wants to view a company on SN to get growth signals, activity data, or leave a view trace. Requires a connected identity with SN subscription (direct mode).

name: edges-salesnavigator-visit-profile

name: edges-url-construction
